entries.4a2f03a1234b3fdf: Tires are divided into two categories by sales destination: new-vehicle tires supplied to automakers, and replacement tires sold when vehicle owners replace their tires. New-vehicle tires exceeded the prior year, due to the expansion of new models supplied in Japan and the winning of original equipment fitment on premium cars, mainly SUV and CUV models, in Europe and North America. Replacement tires exceeded the prior year as sales of high value-added products grew, driven by careful sales activities in Japan, focus on high-inch products (large-size tires) in European countries, and strengthened sales of on-road SUV and CUV tires in North America. The company cites ADVAN and GEOLANDAR, along with winter tires, as high value-added products. Revenue for this category is not separately disclosed.
entries.4a8666beacc33ae0: This business involves rubber and resin products other than tires. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥105,552 million (up 0.3% year on year), accounting for 8.5% of consolidated revenue. The company explains that the Hose and Piping Business exceeded the prior year, as demand from North American automakers rose despite lower demand from domestic construction machinery makers, and that the Industrial Materials Business exceeded the prior year, owing to stable orders for conveyor belts, strong demand for marine products and increased orders for defense equipment.

entries.fc2440e408582173: Tires are divided into those for new vehicles, supplied to automakers, and those for the replacement market. Replacement tires are sold in Japan by sales companies such as Yokohama Tire Japan Co., Ltd., and overseas by companies such as Yokohama Tire Corporation. MB products are supported by demand from customers such as construction machinery manufacturers in Japan and automakers in North America. Among revenue from external customers, no transaction accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue.
